## Checklist

- [ ] Tests and required CI gates pass
- [ ] Update CLI/domain contract docs if behavior changes
- [ ] Add a `changelog.d/` fragment (`direct-<slug>.md`, or `<issue-number>-<slug>.md` if linked to an issue) for user-facing changes, or state why this is not user-facing
- [ ] Include sanitized live-gate evidence if touching LMS interactions
- [ ] Remove real course IDs, names, and other private data from examples or evidence
